description: This PHP class 'VaultRepository' manages database operations related to 'vault' items, including insert, delete, search, read, and update functionalities, with encryption handling for sensitive data.

classes.name: VaultRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing Vault entities in the database, including CRUD operations and encryption handling.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Vault record into the database with encrypted value.

methods.name: deleteByIdAndUserId
methods.description: Deletes a vault record by its ID and user ID.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Returns a SelectQueryBuilder for basic vault data.

methods.name: getFullSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Returns a SelectQueryBuilder for full vault data including sensitive fields.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches vaults based on criteria, with option for full query.

methods.name: getVaultItemName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a vault item by ID and project ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Finds all vaults for a specific project.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds vaults accessible by a specific user.

methods.name: readVaultItem
methods.description: Reads and decrypts a vault item by ID using a password.

methods.name: updateVaultItemById
methods.description: Updates a vault item by ID, decrypting and re-encrypting its value.
